decisions.reason: Displaying the referral code directly on the NFT does not change the commission amount, trigger, recipient, timing, or delivery behavior.
The referral-code display location does not alter allocation of commissions for mints where no referral code is entered.
The existing same-message FAQ MODIFY already records the revision stating that the referral code appears directly on the NFT.
The referral-code display location does not change Small Block ticket issuance, eligibility, reset, funding, or prize parameters.
The transfer state already preserves the NFT mint number as the purchaser's referral code; displaying that code directly on the NFT does not change transfer semantics.
Displaying a referral code on the NFT does not alter any primary-sale revenue allocation or fiat-fee rule.
The referral-code display location does not change Big Block ticket, draw, funding, or winner-selection behavior.
Displaying the referral code directly on the NFT does not change prize announcement or claim behavior.
The referral-code display location does not affect secondary-sale royalties, their allocations, or whether secondary sales generate tickets.
Displaying a referral code directly on the NFT does not modify badge triggers, thresholds, or award destination.
The NFT display change does not alter fiat minting access, dashboard authentication, or wallet requirements for rewards.
Displaying the referral code directly on the NFT has no effect on the current or conditional future project branding.
